description: This file provides Linux-specific implementation of SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol) socket operations, including socket options, connection handling, and server/client setup functions for SCTP communication on Linux systems.

classes.name: rawConn
classes.description: A struct representing a raw socket connection with methods for control, read, and write operations.

classes.name: SCTPConn
classes.description: A struct representing an SCTP connection with methods for data transmission, buffer management, and connection control.

classes.name: SCTPListener
classes.description: A struct representing an SCTP server listener capable of accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: setsockopt
methods.description: Sets socket options at the system level for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: getsockopt
methods.description: Retrieves socket options at the system level for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: Control
methods.description: Method of rawConn to execute a control function on the socket file descriptor.

methods.name: SCTPWrite
methods.description: Sends data over an SCTP connection, optionally including send/receive info.

methods.name: parseSndRcvInfo
methods.description: Parses socket control messages to extract SCTP send/receive information.

methods.name: SCTPRead
methods.description: Reads data from an SCTP connection, handling notifications and extracting SCTP info.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the SCTP connection, sending EOF notification and shutting down the socket.

methods.name: SetWriteBuffer
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for the SCTP connection.

methods.name: GetWriteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the current send buffer size for the SCTP connection.

methods.name: SetReadBuffer
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for the SCTP connection.

methods.name: GetReadBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the current receive buffer size for the SCTP connection.

methods.name: ListenSCTP
methods.description: Starts an SCTP listener on a specified address and port.

methods.name: ListenSCTPExt
methods.description: Starts an SCTP listener with additional options.

methods.name: listenSCTPExtConfig
methods.description: Configures and starts an SCTP listener with socket options and control functions.

methods.name: AcceptSCTP
methods.description: Accepts an incoming SCTP connection.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection (alias for AcceptSCTP).

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the SCTP listener socket.

methods.name: DialSCTP
methods.description: Creates an SCTP connection to a remote address, optionally binding to a local address.

methods.name: DialSCTPExt
methods.description: Creates an SCTP connection with additional options.

methods.name: dialSCTPExtConfig
methods.description: Configures and establishes an SCTP connection with socket options and control functions.
